source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
SKILLED COMMONER

DIFFICULTY 1

Size 1 human
Perception 10 (+0)
Defense 10; Health 10; Insanity d3 – 1; Corruption d3 – 2
Strength 10 (+0), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 10 (+0), Will 10 (+0)
Speed 10
Skill Training The hireling has one of the following talents.
• While the hireling is with the group in a wilderness
environment, the group cannot become lost.
• The hireling can spend 1 hour hunting, trapping, or
foraging to provide nourishment for up to 5 people.
• The hireling can use an action to remove the
frightened affliction from one animal it can reach.
• The hireling grants 1 additional boon when using an
action to help.
• Food the hireling prepares allows characters that
complete a rest to heal 1d6 extra damage.
• The hireling makes rolls to drive or pilot with 2
boons.
• The hireling can use an action to help any creature
that can see and hear it within long range by
performing music.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Quarterstaff (melee) +0 (1d6)

Skill 2 Hirelings
Artisans, surgeons, healers, apothecaries, and similar
professions represent trades that require expertise in
a particular field. Hirelings from these professions
command a higher rate of pay than their more
mundane fellows. Skill 2 hirelings also include guards
who have a modicum of training. Arms and armor
must be provided for them as part of their service.

--- PDF p. 4 ---

DIFFICULTY 1

Size 1 human

Defense 10; Health 10; Insanity d3 – 1; Corruption d3 – 2

Expertise The hireling has expertise in one of the following
areas.
• The hireling makes rolls to stabilize creatures with
2 boons. In addition, if the hireling tends to a resting
character, the character heals extra damage equal
to its healing rate and makes challenge rolls to resist
the effects of disease and poison with 1 boon.
• The hireling can use an action to repair an object,
removing 1d6 damage from it.
• The hireling can create finished items of a particular
kind from provided raw materials. The hireling needs
materials equal to half the item’s price and it takes 4
hours per ss of the item’s price to create the finished
item.

Perception 13 (+3)
Defense 10; Health 9; Insanity d3; Corruption d3 – 2
Strength 9 (–1), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 13 (+3), Will 10 (+0)
Speed 10
Area of Scholarship The scholar is a master in a particular
area of scholarship and an expert in two additional areas.
The scholar can recall obscure information related to the
area of mastery and uncommon information related to
the areas of expertise.
Scholarly Guidance Each creature friendly to the scholar
and within short range makes Intellect rolls with 1 boon
and imposes 1 bane on rolls made against their Intellect.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Club (melee) +0 (1d6)
Hammer (melee or short range) +0 (1d3)

and who prove willing to hire out their services to
an employer takes work. Learning magic often takes
years of effort and people who develop the necessary
skills rarely sell their talent cheaply if at all. A typical
magician has discovered d3 traditions and knows
d3 + 1 spells for each tradition. The traditions and
spells presented below are but possible combinations.
